free_tier.stated: 1 free parallel job with 1,800 minutes a month and 60 minutes per job, with a 10 GB disk

per_object_cap.stated: 60 minutes per job on the free grant; 360 minutes only on a paid parallel job

retention.stated: artifacts and logs follow pipeline retention settings; the minute pool is monthly

egress.terms: no egress charge on the hosted agent itself

interface_detail: an azure-pipelines.yml pipeline; a REST API and the az CLI
tooling: the Microsoft-hosted images; any shell; the Azure CLI preinstalled
chaining: 1,800 minutes is the largest per-job-minute pool of the small providers, and the 60-minute job cap is the smallest

limits.value: 60 minutes per job on the free grant
1,800 minutes a month with 1 free parallel job

identity_cost.detail: the free grant applies only to an Azure DevOps organisation linked to a valid Azure subscription; Azure DevOps billing does not accept the Azure Free Trial, and an Azure account asks for a phone number and a non-prepaid credit or debit card

evidence.proved: one free parallel job with 1,800 minutes a month and a 60-minute maximum job duration; 10 GB of disk; the 360-minute cap applies only with a paid parallel job
the free parallel-job grant needs the organisation linked to a valid Azure subscription
evidence.quote: To receive the free grant of parallel jobs, link your Azure DevOps organization to a valid Azure subscription.

evidence.proved: the Azure Free Trial cannot be the subscription linked for Azure DevOps billing
evidence.quote: Azure DevOps doesn't support the Azure Free Trial.

evidence.proved: an Azure account asks for a phone number and a non-prepaid credit or debit card
evidence.quote: All you need is a phone number, a credit card or a debit card (non-prepaid), and a Microsoft account or a GitHub account.

evidence.proved: the free tier is one job of up to 60 minutes and 1,800 minutes a month; the paid tier allows 360 minutes per job
evidence.quote: | Free tier | One free job that can run up to 60 minutes each time | 1,800 minutes (30 hours) per month |

evidence.proved: the private-project free grant is one parallel job, 60 minutes per job and 1,800 minutes a month
evidence.quote: Private project: One free parallel job that can run for up to 60 minutes each time, until you use 1,800 minutes (30 hours) per month.

notes: Each job on the free grant stops at 60 minutes and the grant ends at 1,800 minutes a month; a paid parallel job lifts the job cap to 360 minutes. The same organisation grant includes one self-hosted parallel job with no time limit, which runs the agent on a machine the user provides.
